Title: 2023-11-22 Hotfix Patch
Subtitle: === Heroes: Anub'arak ===
CleanedNotes:
=== Heroes: Anub'arak ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • [Undocumented] Fixed an issue causing the duration of Anub'arak's Cocoon to not be displayed correctly.

=== Heroes: D.Va ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • [Undocumented] Fixed an issue causing D.Va's Ablative Armor and Diverting Power to display incorrectly in the Death Recap.

=== Heroes: Dehaka ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • [Undocumented] Fixed an issue causing the Knockback from Dehaka's Lurker Strain to cause animation cancels.

=== Heroes: Greymane ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • [Undocumented] Fixed an issue causing Greymane's Alpha Killer to damage non-Heroes.

=== Heroes: Jaina ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • [Undocumented] Fixed an issue causing Jaina's Frost Shards to not allow Frostbolt to hit targets close to each other.

=== Heroes: Maiev ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • [Undocumented] Fixed an issue causing the duration of Maiev's Containment Disc to not be displayed correctly.

=== Heroes: Murky ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • [Undocumented] Fixed an issue causing the visuals of Murky's Octo-Grab to not be visible to Murky when the target is inside a bush and Murky is not inside that bush.

=== Heroes: Sonya ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • [Undocumented] Fixed an issue causing the Unstoppable effect provided by Sonya's Leap to not last the full duration when used in place.

=== Heroes: Zagara ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • [Undocumented] Fixed an issue causing Zagara's Baneling Barrage to display incorrectly in the Death Recap.
